summary.description: The idea in markdown, at most 300 words: its shape, the brief goal it serves or the conflict, and what you left out (procedure ideate.md).

outcome.description: epic: the idea fits the brief. question: it contradicts a brief goal, non-goal or architectural expectation.

epic.description: For outcome epic: the epic ticket to create. null for question.

title.description: What someone can do when it ships.

body.description: Markdown: the problem and who has it, the proposal, the brief goal it serves, out of scope, a link to the spec path.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Testable, covering failure cases, in EARS form.

slices.description: Candidate tickets in build order; refinement cuts the real ones.

summary.description: One line: what the slice does.

spec.description: For outcome epic: the spec draft to open as a PR. null for question.

path.description: specs/<slug>.md, the slug lowercase words joined by hyphens.

markdown.description: Problem, Who it is for, Proposal, Fits the brief, Acceptance criteria, Out of scope, Open questions; within 600 words.

questions.description: Exactly one for outcome question; empty for epic.

question.description: One plain sentence ending in a question mark, naming the brief goal or non-goal the idea contradicts. Format: ideate.md.

context.description: Two to four sentences: the idea in plain words, the brief line it contradicts (quoted), why it matters now.

options.description: Choices (2-5), usually Update the brief, Change the idea, Drop it. Each says what choosing it does or costs.

label.description: The option as Andy would answer it.

consequence.description: What choosing it does or costs.

recommendation.description: The answer you would pick, exactly the label of one option, with a one-line reason.
